# Dev Completion Report

## What Was Done
Replaced the native HTML `title` attribute on benchmark column headers with a custom CSS-only tooltip tied exclusively to the "i" info icon. The old `title={c.tip}` on the `<th>` element caused the browser to show a tooltip whenever the cursor entered the entire table header cell. The new implementation uses Tailwind's named group variant (`group/info` / `group-hover/info`) scoped to a 12×12px SVG icon, so the tooltip only appears when hovering that icon.

## Files Changed
- `src/app/components/ModelComparisonTeaser.tsx` — removed `title={c.tip}` from `<th>`; added inline "i" SVG icon with a `group/info`-scoped tooltip span for each benchmark column header.

## Testing
- Verified the diff: old code used `title={c.tip}` (browser native, fires on any cell hover); new code uses `group-hover/info:opacity-100` scoped to the icon's wrapping `<span>`.
- The tooltip `<span>` has `pointer-events-none` so it doesn't expand the hover target beyond the icon itself.
- The 12×12px icon is the sole pointer-events area; hovering anywhere else in the column header no longer triggers the tooltip.

## Notes
- This is a purely CSS-driven change — no React state, no JS event handlers.
- The SVG icon itself fades from 50% to 100% opacity on hover as a visual affordance that it's interactive.
- Accessibility: the native `title` provided screen-reader text; the new tooltip does not. If accessibility is a concern, adding `aria-label` to the SVG or a `role="tooltip"` + `aria-describedby` pattern would be the next step.

# QA Report

## Verdict: PASS

## Summary
The implementation correctly addresses the reported bug. The developer removed the native HTML `title={c.tip}` attribute from the `<th>` element (which triggered a browser tooltip on any cell hover) and replaced it with a CSS-only tooltip scoped exclusively to a 12×12px "i" SVG icon using Tailwind v4's named group variant `group/info`. The compiled CSS at `/home/greg/pro/web/apps/gta-labs/.next/static/css/app/layout.css` confirms the `group-hover/info:opacity-100` class is correctly generated and scoped — it resolves to `&:is(:where(.group/info):hover *)`, meaning the tooltip only triggers when hovering the icon's wrapping span. The `pointer-events-none` on the tooltip span correctly prevents the floating tooltip element itself from expanding the hover target. The fix is clean, minimal, and works within Tailwind v4's scanning and compilation pipeline.

## Defects Found

**P3-01: Accessibility regression — tooltip text no longer reachable by screen readers.**
The removed `title` attribute provided some (imperfect) screen reader coverage. The new tooltip span has no `aria-label`, `role="tooltip"`, or `aria-describedby` pairing. Keyboard-only and screen reader users cannot access the benchmark descriptions. Developer acknowledged this gap in their report. The original `title` on `<th>` was also weak accessibility, so this isn't a hard regression, but it is a net loss.

**P3-02: Test URL (localhost:3001) was not live during QA.**
The dev server was not running at test time, so live browser interaction testing (hover precision, tooltip fade behavior, mobile touch behavior) could not be performed. Code analysis and compiled CSS output were used as a proxy. This is a process note, not a functional defect — the implementation passes static analysis.

## Recommendation
**PASS.** The primary requirement is met: tooltips are now scoped to the "i" icon hover only, and the native title-on-th behavior is removed. No P0 or P1 defects found. The P3 accessibility gap should be tracked as a follow-up (add `aria-label` to the SVG or implement a proper `role="tooltip"` + `aria-describedby` pattern) but does not block this sprint.
